title: On the Optimality of Random Features under General Conditions: Misspecified Cases and Robust Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.18333v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Random features provide a standard approach to scaling kernel methods to large datasets by approximating the kernel with a finite-dimensional feature map. Existing works of random feature methods primarily focus on well-specified models and light-tailed noise conditions, leaving a gap in understanding their performance under more general conditions, such as misspecified models and heavy-tailed noise. In this paper, we provide a comprehensive and improved analysis of kernel ridge regression with random features (KRR-RF) under general conditions. In the light-tailed noise setting, we improve upon the worst-case uniform bounds of the feature map used in the previous works and lead to the minimax optimal learning rates with $2r+\gamma>\alpha_0$, where $(r,\gamma,\alpha_0)$ denote the regularity of the target function, the effective dimension of the kernel, and the embedding index of the RKHS, respectively. translated_title: 一般条件下随机特征的最优性：模型误设情形与鲁棒学习
translated_abstract: 随机特征通过用有限维特征映射来近似核函数，为将核方法扩展到大规模数据集提供了一种标准方法。现有的随机特征方法研究主要集中在良设模型和轻尾噪声条件下，这使得在更一般的条件下（如模型误设和重尾噪声）理解其性能方面存在研究空白。本文在一般条件下对带随机特征的核岭回归（KRR-RF）进行了全面且改进的分析。在轻尾噪声设置下，我们改进了以往工作中所使用的特征映射的最坏情况一致界，并在 $2r+\gamma>\alpha_0$ 的条件下得到了极小化极大最优学习率，其中 $(r,\gamma,\alpha_0)$ 分别表示目标函数的正则性、核的有效维度以及再生核希尔伯特空间（RKHS）的嵌入指数。在重尾噪声设置下，……
tldr: 本文在模型误设与重尾噪声等更一般的条件下对带随机特征的核岭回归进行了全面分析，改进了特征映射的一致界并证明了极小化极大最优学习率。
en_tdlr: This paper provides a comprehensive and improved analysis of kernel ridge regression with random features under general conditions, achieving minimax optimal learning rates even in misspecified and heavy-tailed noise settings.
